title: Soulgazer Eye-intensifying Mascara and Eyeliner Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Peptide✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Long-wearing✓ Hypoallergenic✓ Lengthening✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A three piece eye set with mini and full size lengthening mascara and a waterproof gel eyeliner.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid: Attracts water and locks in hydration for a smooth glide.

- Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17: Supports visibly longer, fuller lashes in six to eight weeks.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of phthalates, mineral oil, sulfates SLS & SLES, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance.



How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Wear Soulgazer Eyeliner how you feel it—sharply precise or purposefully smudgy. Use the built-in sharpener and attached smudger tool to get your desired look. After use, press the cap tightly to preserve the formula’s creaminess.
-To apply Soulgazer Mascara, start with the brush held horizontally, press lightly at the base of the lashes, wiggle, and pull upwards. Repeat as desired to coat, lengthen, and lift every lash.
Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid: Attracts water and locks in hydration for a smooth glide.
-Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17: Supports visibly longer, fuller lashes in six to eight weeks.

Soulgazer Intensifying Waterproof Gel Eyeliner – Allure:
Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Synthetic Wax, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Hydrogenated Polydecene, Mica, Silica Silylate, Polybutene, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Cire De Carnauba, Trihydroxystearin, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Ethylene/Propylene Copolymer, Kaolin, Silica, Phenoxyethanol [+/-: CI 77007 (Ultramarines), CI 77491 (Iron Oxide), CI 77742 (Manganese Violet), CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide).

Soulgazer Lengthening Mascara + Lash Serum in 1 for Sensitive Eyes - Hypnotize:
Water/Aqua/Eau, Iron Oxides (CI 77499), Hydrogenated Olive Oil Stearyl Esters, Stearic Acid, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/ Cire de Carnauba, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Myrica Pubescens Fruit Wax, Pullulan, Aminomethyl Propanediol, Oleic/Linoleic/Linolenic Polyglycerides, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Galactoarabinan, Xanthan Gum, Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Hydroxyacetophenone.

Soulgazer Lengthening Mascara + Lash Serum in 1 for Sensitive Eyes - Allure:
Water/Aqua/Eau, Hydrogenated Olive Oil Stearyl Esters, Stearic Acid, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Copernicia Cerifera Cera, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Myrica Pubescens Fruit Wax/Cera, Pullulan, Aminomethyl Propanediol, Oleic/Linoleic/Linolenic Polyglycerides, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Galactoarabinan, Xanthan Gum, Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Hydroxyacetophenone [+/-: Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499)].
